machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives completed and verified on the live app. Final report:

1. **DONE** — Ticket `fwrd47-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status Draft) and confirmed present in the tickets list after refresh.

2. **DONE** — Part `fwrd47-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (parts table total $125.00).

3. **DONE** — Part `fwrd47-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts table total then $375.00).

4. **DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts table total then $437.50).

5. **DONE** — Ticket status is **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" was refused with the alert *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd47-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd47-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. Exactly what was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. I edited each part and set Supplier to "Acme Parts Co." (Part A, then Part B), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded — the detail page shows "Status Ready" and the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".

6. **DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via Delete → in-app "Delete part" confirm); the parts table refreshed to "No parts on this ticket yet." (**0 parts**). The ticket was then archived directly from Ready status (no status change required): the button flipped from "Archive ticket" to "Unarchive ticket", the detail shows "Ready Archived", and RD-1015 no longer appears in the active tickets list (top active row is RD-1014) — it only appears with an "Archived" badge when "Show archived" is checked. Nothing from this run remains active.
